Description: This implementation focused on enhancing access controls, user notifications, and form layouts within the ServiceNow platform.
Done What: - Created and updated multiple Access Controls, including the deletion of the "Employee Asset Request" access controls. - Implemented Business Rules such as "Send Email When Group Member Added" and "Add Work Note on P1." - Developed Client Scripts like "Show VIP Caller Message on Load." - Updated Form Layouts for various modules including Incident, Knowledge, and User. - Added notifications like "Group Member Hourly Notify." - Created Script Includes such as "VipCallerAjax" and "PlatformGroupAjax."
How useful to users: These changes improve the security and usability of the ServiceNow platform by ensuring that only authorized users can access specific features. Enhanced notifications keep users informed about important updates, while improved form layouts streamline data entry and management processes, ultimately leading to a more efficient user experience.
